q: Misiurewicz-Thurston classification of critically finite rational maps uses the concept of a Thurston map. A Thurston map has a topological obstruction to being realized as a rational map if:
opts: It has more than 2 critical values
There exists a Thurston obstruction: a multicurve with eigenvalue ≥ 1 of the associated linear operator
The map is not postcritically finite
exp: Thurston's theorem (1982): a postcritically finite branched cover f: S² → S² is equivalent to a rational map iff it has no Thurston obstruction—no multicurve Γ with spectral radius of f_Γ ≥ 1. This solves the realization problem for such maps.
